scope: Existing48 native probe episodes read;24 complete route reward ledgers, no new simulator/inference/training/policy edits

ledger_semantics.recorded_trace_reward: Frozen BASE precision-arrival-v3 only; native evaluator never added W8
ledger_semantics.cutoff: Actual t0 through confirmed goal4, reflecting training success termination; later40s hover excluded
ledger_semantics.post_step_rates: Next recorded pre-action actor_io body_rates; completion precedes final trace row, so every route-prefix rate is measured
ledger_semantics.offline_W8: Exact -8*dt*finite-active-segment-distance-squared using pre-update event targets, added only as counterfactual score on recorded states
ledger_semantics.discounted_score: sum gamma_PPO**row_index * reconstructed_component, not a measured training return
ledger_semantics.causal_limit: Reward-scale comparison is not a gradient attribution; fixed70 bonuses cancel in undiscounted complete-route comparisons but their timing matters under gamma.995
ledger_semantics.KL: Weight.1 * minibatch mean KL(current Normal || frozen initial wind Normal), summed across4actions; optimizer loss, not environment reward
